P0300.title: Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
P0300.definition: The engine is misfiring, meaning one or more cylinders are not firing correctly.
P0300.why_it_matters: Persistent misfires can damage the catalytic converter and cause unsafe driving conditions due to power loss.
P0300.recommended_action: Avoid hard acceleration. If the engine shakes heavily or the check-engine light flashes, stop driving and arrange repair.

P0420.title: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
P0420.definition: The catalytic converter is not operating efficiently based on oxygen sensor readings.
P0420.why_it_matters: Emissions increase and performance may degrade over time. Ignoring it can lead to higher repair costs.
P0420.recommended_action: Book a service soon. Check for exhaust leaks and verify oxygen sensor readings before replacing the catalytic converter.

P0171.title: System Too Lean (Bank 1)
P0171.definition: The ECU detects the air-fuel mixture is too lean (too much air, not enough fuel).
P0171.why_it_matters: Can cause hesitation, misfires, and long-term engine damage if ignored.
P0171.recommended_action: Inspect for vacuum leaks, clean/inspect MAF sensor, and check fuel pressure.
